mapper.insert: insert into ssm_user_profile ( user_name, entity_type, entity_id, entity_name, created_by, created_time ) values ( #{userName}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{entityName}, #{createdBy}, now() )
mapper.update: update ssm_user_profile set entity_id = #{entityId}, entity_name = #{entityName}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = now() where pkid = #{pkId}
mapper.select: SELECT pkid as pkId, user_name as userName, entity_type as entityType, entity_id as entityId, entity_name as entityName, created_by as createdBy, created_time as createdTime, updated_by as updatedBy, updated_time as updatedTime FROM ssm_user_profile WHERE user_name = #{userName} and entity_type = #{entityType} limit 1;
